# x402 Text Diff

> Lightweight deterministic text/JSON line & word diff for agents. Produces structured change sets or unified-style output. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/diff – service info
- POST /api/diff – paid diff

## Pricing

~0.005 – 0.015 USDC per call (default max 0.01 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "a": "original text or stringified JSON",
  "b": "modified text or stringified JSON",
  "options": {
    "mode": "lines|words|chars",
    "context": 2,
    "format": "structured|unified"
  }
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "diff": [ /* structured ops or unified string */ ],
  "meta": { "adds": 3, "removes": 1, "mode": "lines" }
}
```

Ideal for autonomous agents doing change detection, version comparison, or patch generation before commits / RAG updates.
